result.stdout:
Usage:
  nuscope inspect <path-to.dll|path-to.nupkg|package-id> [--format text|json] [--include-non-public] [--search term] [--kind kind]
                                                    [--tfm target-framework] [--version version] [--prerelease] [--source url]
  nuscope skill local|global

Kinds: type, method, property, field, event, constructor
Skill targets: local installs to the nearest project under .agents/skills/nuscope; global installs under ~/.agents/skills/nuscope.
Default source: https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
